fields.Name: T088 - Credential Categories Hierarchical Tree
fields.Description: Recursive parent/child tree built client-side (buildTree) with expand/collapse-all and per-node detail — not a flat grid; no other area renders a self-built hierarchy tree.
fields.ExpectedOutcomes:
{
  "goalCompleted": true,
  "minConfidence": 0.7,
  "maxSteps": 35,
  "judgeValidationCriteria": [
    "A nested/indented category tree renders OR a valid empty state is shown",
    "Expand/Collapse controls change the visible tree depth",
    "Selecting a category node opens a detail panel with counts (Credential Types / Subcategories)",
    "No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages"
  ]
}
